Name: MOVE_PARAM_ST
Description: Movement animation sets (idle, walk, dash, evasion, turn and flight animation IDs per row), a layout carried over from earlier games. No reader of this param was found in Elden Ring: changing it appears to have no effect.

Fields.Name: Stay ID
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail sets an idle animation ID here (0 in most rows).

Fields.Name: Walk - Forward
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail sets an animation ID here (200 in most rows).

Fields.Name: Walk - Backward
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail sets an animation ID here (201 in most rows).
